mapper.select: SELECT lcv.business_group_id business_group_id ,lbg.business_group_name ,lcv.organization_id AS company_id ,lcv.name company_name ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 1, 'Y', 'N') FROM lgcom_role_biz_org_n lr WHERE lr.organization_type_code = 'C' AND lr.company_id = lcv.organization_id AND lr.role_code = #{roleCode} AND ROWNUM = 1) AS yn_flag FROM lgcom_company_v lcv ,(SELECT lcc.common_code business_group_id ,lcc.common_code_desc business_group_name FROM lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_BUSINESS_GROUP_CODE') lbg WHERE NVL(lcv.date_to, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND lcv.business_group_id = lbg.business_group_id ORDER BY 1, 4

insert.if: INSERT INTO lgcom_role_biz_org_n ( role_business_organization_id , role_code , organization_type_code , company_id , created_by , creation_date , last_updated_by , last_update_date ) VALUES ( lgcom_role_biz_org_n_seq.nextval , #{roleCode} , #{organizationTypeCode} , #{companyId} , #{sessionUserId} , SYSDATE , #{sessionUserId} , SYSDATE )
